summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: added Update container (prologue, algebra) in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update container, with the empty-request path translating the parsed declarations via translatePrologue; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py mirroring prepareQuery; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py covers prepare/apply, reuse, initNs, direct evaluation, container shape (including empty and declarations-only requests), no-mutation check, and empty update strings. Not committed. Tests were not run, per instructions; the existing prepareQuery and DAWG update tests still need to be run to confirm.
